doc.alert_prop_children: Content of the alert (treated as the description).
doc.alert_prop_icon: Custom icon. When omitted, a default icon matching the intent is displayed.
doc.alert_prop_onClose: Called when the close button is clicked. Providing it shows the close button.
doc.alert_prop_titleTag:
HTML tag used for the alert title.
@default "h4"
doc.autosave_prop_errorMessage: Error message (a default message is used when omitted).
doc.banner_prop_icon:
Whether to show the icon, or a custom icon element.
@default true
doc.banner_prop_onClose: Called when the close button is clicked. Providing it shows the close button.
doc.errorBoundary_prop_fallback: Component or element displayed when an error occurs. When a function is passed, it is called as (error, errorInfo, reset) => ReactNode.
doc.errorBoundary_prop_onReset: Called when the error is reset.
doc.indicator_prop_children: Element the indicator dot is attached to. If omitted, only the dot is rendered.
doc.indicator_prop_color:
Color of the dot. Accepts a design token color name or any CSS color value.
@default "primary"
doc.indicator_prop_inline:
If true, renders the dot inline instead of positioning it on a corner.
@default false
doc.indicator_prop_position:
Corner of the children the dot is placed at.
@default "top-right"
doc.indicator_prop_pulse:
If true, the dot pulses to draw attention.
@default false
doc.loader_prop_color:
Color of the loader. Accepts a design token color name or "currentColor".
@default "primary"
doc.loadingOverlay_prop_blur:
Strength of the backdrop blur effect.
@default "sm"
doc.loadingOverlay_prop_children: Custom loading content, replacing the default indicator.
doc.loadingOverlay_prop_fixed:
Whether to use position: fixed (covers the whole screen).
@default false
doc.loadingOverlay_prop_message: Loading message displayed below the indicator.
doc.loadingOverlay_prop_visible:
Whether the overlay is shown.
@default false
doc.progress_prop_indeterminate:
If true, shows an indeterminate animation instead of a value.
@default false
doc.progress_prop_label: Text label displayed above the bar.
doc.progress_prop_max:
Maximum value of the progress bar.
@default 100
doc.progress_prop_showValue:
Whether to display the current value as a percentage.
@default false
doc.progress_prop_value:
Current value of the progress bar.
@default 0
doc.result_prop_intent:
Semantic intent — determines the icon and color.
@default "default"
doc.result_prop_status:
HTTP error status — adds a status-specific CSS class and shows a neutral icon.
Use for error pages (404, 403, 500).
doc.scrollProgress_prop_target: Element whose scroll position is tracked. Defaults to `window`.
doc.skeleton_prop_animation:
Type of animation (`pulse`: slow fade, `wave`: left-to-right wave, `none`: no animation).
@default "pulse"
doc.skeleton_prop_height: Height, including a CSS unit (px, %, rem, etc.).
doc.skeleton_prop_variant:
Shape of the skeleton (`text`: line of text, `rect`: rectangle, `circle`: circle).
@default "text"
doc.skeleton_prop_width: Width, including a CSS unit (px, %, rem, etc.).
doc.snackbar_prop_autoHideDuration:
Time in milliseconds before the snackbar closes automatically. Set 0 to disable auto-close.
@default 5000
doc.snackbar_prop_onAction: Called when the action button is clicked.
doc.snackbar_prop_onClose: Called when the snackbar is closed.
doc.snackbar_prop_open:
Whether the snackbar is shown.
@default false
doc.snackbar_prop_showCloseButton:
Whether to show a close button.
@default false
doc.spinner_prop_color:
Color of the spinner. Accepts a design token color name or "currentColor".
@default "primary"
doc.spinner_prop_label: Text label displayed next to the spinner.
doc.spinner_prop_labelPosition:
Position of the label relative to the spinner.
@default "right"
doc.toast_prop_description: Description text displayed below the title.
doc.toast_prop_duration:
Time in milliseconds before the toast closes automatically. Set 0 to disable auto-close.
@default 3000
doc.toast_prop_id: Identifier of the toast, passed to onClose. Used by ToastProvider to manage a stack.
doc.toast_prop_onClose: Called with the toast id when the toast is closed.
doc.toast_prop_open:
Whether the toast is shown.
@default true
doc.tour_prop_onClose: Called when the tour is dismissed before completion.
doc.tour_prop_onFinish: Called when the last step is completed.
doc.tour_prop_steps: Steps of the tour. Each step targets an element via a CSS selector.
